**About Us**
 Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.
   

  

**The Role**
 Are you someone who builds AI agents and thinks about how to automate the world? Fanatics wants you.
   

  

 We're looking for a full\-time
 **AI Engineer** 
 to help shape and execute Fanatics' AI strategy across the company. You'll work directly with business leaders to identify high\-impact automation opportunities, design and ship agentic workflows, and help set the bar for how AI gets deployed at Fanatics.
   

  

 This is not an "ideate and hand off" role. You'll own problems end\-to\-end: define them, design the solution, build the agent or workflow, prove it works, and partner with stakeholders to scale it. If you're technical enough to build, strategic enough to prioritize, and entrepreneurial enough to spot the right opportunities, this is your role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders across Fanatics to identify, prioritize, and deliver on AI automation opportunities that meaningfully move the business.
* Design, build, and deploy custom agents and agentic workflows using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and the modern agent stack (MCP servers, agent SDKs, orchestration tools, computer use / browser automation, evals).
* Contribute directly to Fanatics' AI strategy: which tools to invest in, which workflows to prioritize, and how to measure impact across functions.
* Take ideas from concept to production: scope the problem, design the solution, build the prototype, run evals, and drive adoption.
* Help shape AI governance and best practices, including tool evaluation, security and InfoSec coordination, and tracking adoption metrics across the enterprise.
* Ask the hard questions: Is this the right problem to automate? What does "good" look like? How do we measure ROI?
* Bring your own ideas. This role rewards creativity and judgment as much as execution.


**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a closely related field preferred.
* Hands\-on experience building with frontier LLMs, including designing and shipping custom agents or agentic workflows that solve real business problems.
* Familiarity with the modern AI stack: LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation methods.
* Comfort working in code (Python preferred) and a willingness to learn whatever the right tool for the job turns out to be.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. Explaining your AI work clearly is just as important as building it.
* Strategic mindset paired with a "get it done" attitude.
* Bonus points if you're a fan of sports, collectibles, or fandom culture (because we're a little obsessed).


**Why You'll Love It Here**
* Real ownership of real projects, with visibility across the entire Fanatics enterprise (Commerce, Collectibles, Betting \& Gaming, Corporate).
* A front\-row seat, and a real voice, in how a global sports and collectibles company adopts AI.
* Mentorship and collaboration with senior leaders across the business.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) plan with company match.
* Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave.
* Wellness benefits and a learning \& development stipend.
* NYC office with daily in\-person collaboration.
* Employee discount on Fanatics products and (yes) some sweet Fanatics swag.


**Final Word**
 If you're ready to build agents, drive strategy, and ship AI that actually moves a global sports and collectibles business, let's talk. This is where your ideas get built.

Zoox is looking for an embedded software engineer to join our Firmware Platforms team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, extending, and maintaining support for multiple embedded platforms for the Zoox vehicle. You will work closely with electrical engineers, embedded software engineers, and validation engineers to enable support for new advanced platforms and accelerate application development across multiple projects. We are looking for people who are passionate about diving deep into the hardware and creating robust and reusable software.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect, develop, debug, optimize, review, and test software for multiple real\-time embedded platforms
* Develop and maintain board support packages for multiple platforms, including compiler, bootloader, drivers, and real\-time operating system
* Build low\-level frameworks, interfaces, and infrastructure to make our embedded application development faster, simpler, more portable, and more testable
* Bring\-up of new embedded platforms by working with electrical engineers, suppliers, and vendors to identify and solve hardware and low\-level software issues
* Contribute to all phases of the software development cycle, including prototyping, requirements capture, design, implementation, and validation


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of experience developing real\-time embedded software for distributed electromechanical systems
* Strong embedded C\+\+/C programming experience
* Strong experience with micro\-controllers and/or microprocessors
* Programming skills in C and C\+\+, Linux, QNX, FreeRTOS, or SafeRTOS
* Experience with common lab equipment and data acquisition equipment(DACs, debuggers, power supplies, multimeters, etc.)


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience with automotive communication protocols and stacks (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, Wifi, LTE, 5G, NFC, UWB, etc.)
* Ability to read and provide feedback on PCB schematics
